ja: あの子と二人きりでいるのは、もううんざりしてたの。

key: I had enough before it even started, but I still pushed you out.
en: I had enough before it even started, but I still pushed you out.
ja: 始まる前から、もう十分だったのに、それでもあなたを遠ざけてた。

key: I don't regret many things in my life, but I regret that.
en: I don't regret many things in my life, but I regret that.
ja: 人生で後悔してることはあまりないけど、それは後悔してる。

key: FLORINIA: ...Appreciated.
en: FLORINIA: ...Appreciated.
ja: フロリニア: ……感謝します。

key: ...On a different subject, the other Anomaly escaped somewhere to the north, correct?
en: ...On a different subject, the other Anomaly escaped somewhere to the north, correct?
ja: ……話は変わりますが、もう一体のアノマリーは北の方へ逃げたのですよね?

key: Hypothesis: It returned to the accompanying New World pocket.
en: Hypothesis: It returned to the accompanying New World pocket.
ja: 仮説: それに付随するニューワールドの領域へと戻ったのでしょう。

key: It may be prudent to contain it while we engage in...
en: It may be prudent to contain it while we engage in...
ja: 対処している間に、それを封じ込めるのが賢明かもしれません……

key: Or rather, while we look after Amaria.
en: Or rather, while we look after Amaria.
ja: というより、アマリアの様子を見ている間に。

key: I would prefer to stay with her for now...
en: I would prefer to stay with her for now...
ja: 今は彼女のそばにいたいのですが……

key: AMARIA: Please be okay, please be okay, please be okay...
en: AMARIA: Please be okay, please be okay, please be okay...
ja: アマリア: お願い大丈夫でいて、お願い大丈夫でいて、お願い大丈夫でいて……

key: FLORINIA: Her breathing appears to have steadied...
en: FLORINIA: Her breathing appears to have steadied...
ja: フロリニア: 呼吸は安定してきたようです……

key: AMARIA: I wouldn't be able to live with myself if we lost you because of something like this...
en: AMARIA: I wouldn't be able to live with myself if we lost you because of something like this...
ja: アマリア: こんなことであなたを失ったら、あたし自分を許せない……

key: Because of-- because of me.
en: Because of-- because of me.
ja: だって――だってあたしのせいで。

key: Again.
en: Again.
ja: またしても

key: Why is it always like this?
en: Why is it always like this?
ja: どうしていつもこうなるんだろう?

key: No matter how hard I try, I just end up hurting the people around me...
en: No matter how hard I try, I just end up hurting the people around me...
ja: どんなに頑張っても、結局まわりの人を傷つけることになる……

key: FLORINIA: ...That may be an inappropriate conclusion to draw from the available data.
en: FLORINIA: ...That may be an inappropriate conclusion to draw from the available data.
ja: フロリニア: ……それは、手元のデータから導くには不適切な結論かもしれません。

key: AMARIA: What data?
en: AMARIA: What data?
ja: アマリア: 何のデータ?

key: We were both mind-controlled, and Titania's laying out on the ground,
en: We were both mind-controlled, and Titania's laying out on the ground,
ja: あたしたち二人とも精神を操られてたし、ティタニアは地面に倒れてるし、

key: You're only just remembering how to feel anything,
en: You're only just remembering how to feel anything,
ja: あなたはやっと、何かを感じる方法を思い出し始めたばかりだし、

key: And let's not even mention the time I totally ruined everything with \PN by panicking and trying to drown him.
en: And let's not even mention the time I totally ruined everything with \PN by panicking and trying to drown him.
ja: パニックになって彼を溺れさせようとして、\PNとのことを台無しにしたあの時のことなんて、言うまでもないし。

key: And let's not even mention the time I totally ruined everything with \PN by panicking and trying to drown her.
en: And let's not even mention the time I totally ruined everything with \PN by panicking and trying to drown her.
ja: パニックになって彼女を溺れさせようとして、\PNとのことを台無しにしたあの時のことなんて、言うまでもないし。

key: And let's not even mention the time I totally ruined everything with \PN by panicking and trying to drown them.
en: And let's not even mention the time I totally ruined everything with \PN by panicking and trying to drown them.
ja: パニックになって彼らを溺れさせようとして、\PNとのことを台無しにしたあの時のことなんて、言うまでもないし。

key: And let's not even talk about what \PN must think of me after the melt down I had at my gym...
en: And let's not even talk about what \PN must think of me after the melt down I had at my gym...
ja: あたしのジムで感情崩壊した後、\PNがあたしのことをどう思ってるかなんて、話したくもない……

key: FLORINIA: Those circumstances and their consequences may be undeniable...
en: FLORINIA: Those circumstances and their consequences may be undeniable...
ja: フロリニア: それらの状況とその結果は、否定できないものかもしれません……

key: ...However they are also presented in bias and ignorance to the positive experiences you've had with others.
en: ...However they are also presented in bias and ignorance to the positive experiences you've had with others.
ja: ……しかし、それらはまた、あなたが他者と共有してきた前向きな経験を無視した偏見の中で語られているものでもあります。

key: Do you remember when you tried to teach me to swim?
en: Do you remember when you tried to teach me to swim?
ja: あなたが、わたしに泳ぎを教えようとしてくれた時のことを覚えていますか?

key: AMARIA: You were awful at it.
en: AMARIA: You were awful at it.
ja: アマリア: あなた、ひどい下手さだったよね。

key: A full week in the pool after school and you could barely doggy paddle.
en: A full week in the pool after school and you could barely doggy paddle.
ja: 放課後まる一週間プールに通っても、犬かきすらまともにできなかった。

key: And then your grandpa walked in when I was trying to float you across mid-backstroke and thought we were doing something indecent...
en: And then your grandpa walked in when I was trying to float you across mid-backstroke and thought we were doing something indecent...
ja: それで、背泳ぎの途中であなたを浮かせようとしてたら、おじいちゃんが入ってきて、あたしたちがはしたないことしてると思っちゃって……

key: ...And then I panicked like I always do, grabbed you, and ran.
en: ...And then I panicked like I always do, grabbed you, and ran.
ja: ……それでいつも通りパニックになって、あなたをつかんで逃げたんだよね。

key: FLORINIA: And then?
en: FLORINIA: And then?
ja: フロリニア: それから?

key: AMARIA: Well, he chased us.
en: AMARIA: Well, he chased us.
ja: アマリア: まあ、追いかけられて。

key: Or, no-- he got the custodians to do it instead, right?
en: Or, no-- he got the custodians to do it instead, right?
ja: いや、違うか――代わりに用務員さんたちに追わせたんだよね?

key: FLORINIA: You ran circles from one around his own cleaning cart and then spilled the soap water across the floor.
en: FLORINIA: You ran circles from one around his own cleaning cart and then spilled the soap water across the floor.
ja: フロリニア: あなたは用務員の掃除カートの周りをぐるぐる回って逃げて、せっけん水を床いっぱいにこぼしましたね。

key: AMARIA: Oh-- right, and then all three of them piled up cuz they tried to run after us and slipped on it!
en: AMARIA: Oh-- right, and then all three of them piled up cuz they tried to run after us and slipped on it!
ja: アマリア: あ――そうだ、それで三人とも追いかけようとして、それで滑って重なっちゃったんだよね!

key: Okay, seeing that guy try to pull himself up off the floor covered in suds was a riot!
en: Okay, seeing that guy try to pull himself up off the floor covered in suds was a riot!
ja: 泡まみれの床から立ち上がろうとしてるあの人を見た時、めちゃくちゃ笑えたよね!

key: I was sure he had grown like two extra moustaches!
en: I was sure he had grown like two extra moustaches!
ja: 口ひげが2本くらい増えたみたいに見えたもん!

key: But your grandpa grounded you for like, what, two weeks after that?
en: But your grandpa grounded you for like, what, two weeks after that?
ja: でもあの後、おじいちゃんに2週間くらい外出禁止にされたんだっけ?

key: He didn't let you out of your room or talk to anyone!
en: He didn't let you out of your room or talk to anyone!
ja: 部屋から出してもくれなかったし、誰とも話させてもらえなかったよね!

key: I felt so bad-- that was all my fault too!
en: I felt so bad-- that was all my fault too!
ja: すごく申し訳なかった――あれも全部あたしのせいだったし!

key: FLORINIA: No, you didn't do anything wrong.
en: FLORINIA: No, you didn't do anything wrong.
ja: フロリニア: いいえ、あなたは何も悪いことはしていません。

key: And... to be honest, even if I did get in trouble,
en: And... to be honest, even if I did get in trouble,
ja: それに……正直に言うと、たとえしかられたとしても、

key: I had more fun in those ten minutes than I have in all the time since we graduated combined.
en: I had more fun in those ten minutes than I have in all the time since we graduated combined.
ja: あの10分間の方が、卒業してからの時間を全部合わせたよりも楽しかったのです。

key: There are many cases like that.
en: There are many cases like that.
ja: そういうことは、他にもたくさんあります。

key: You assess yourself with undue negativity because you have inadequate information.
en: You assess yourself with undue negativity because you have inadequate information.
ja: 情報が不十分なせいで、あなたは自分自身を不当に否定的に評価しているのです。

key: It is impossible for you to be accurately aware of how much anyone else enjoys being around you.
en: It is impossible for you to be accurately aware of how much anyone else enjoys being around you.
ja: 他の誰かが、あなたと一緒にいることをどれほど楽しんでいるかを、あなたが正確に知ることは不可能です。

key: That chase is one of my most treasured memories.
en: That chase is one of my most treasured memories.
ja: あの追いかけっこは、わたしにとって最も大切な思い出のひとつです。

key: AMARIA: ...Oh.
en: AMARIA: ...Oh.
ja: アマリア: ……あ。

key: I didn't realize it meant that much to you.
en: I didn't realize it meant that much to you.
ja: そんなに大事な思い出だったなんて、気づかなかった。

key: I... see.
en: I... see.
ja: そう……なんだ。

key: FLORINIA: ...On a different subject, the other Anomaly escaped somewhere to the north, correct?
en: FLORINIA: ...On a different subject, the other Anomaly escaped somewhere to the north, correct?
ja: フロリニア: ……話は変わりますが、もう一体のアノマリーは北の方へ逃げたのですよね?

key: Or rather, while we look after Titania.
en: Or rather, while we look after Titania.
ja: というより、ティタニアの様子を見ている間に。

key: I would prefer to stay here for now...
en: I would prefer to stay here for now...
ja: 今はここに残りたいのですが……

key: FLORINIA: It may be prudent to contain the escaping legendary while we look after her.
en: FLORINIA: It may be prudent to contain the escaping legendary while we look after her.
ja: フロリニア: 彼女の様子を見ている間に、逃げた伝説のポケモンを封じ込めるのが賢明かもしれません。

key: I believe it escaped into the New World space at the north end of this cave system.
en: I believe it escaped into the New World space at the north end of this cave system.
ja: この洞窟群の北の端にあるニューワールド空間へと逃げ込んだと考えられます。

key: For now, I'd like to stay here...
en: For now, I'd like to stay here...
ja: 今はここにいたいのですが……

key: JULIA: Okay, so the gang's back together, lives were saved, friendships reforged, and \PN got some sick Legendary action--
en: JULIA: Okay, so the gang's back together, lives were saved, friendships reforged, and \PN got some sick Legendary action--
ja: ジュリア: よし、それでみんな集まって、命は救われて、友情も修復されて、\PNはヤバい伝説とのバトルまで経験して――

key: So does this mean we can all be besties again?!
en: So does this mean we can all be besties again?!
ja: つまり、アタシたちまた親友になれるってこと?!

key: FLORINIA: I don't... feel like that would be wise.
en: FLORINIA: I don't... feel like that would be wise.
ja: フロリニア: それは……賢明とは思えません。

key: JULIA: Okayyeahwhatever, so maybe not BESTIES, but like,
en: JULIA: Okayyeahwhatever, so maybe not BESTIES, but like,
ja: ジュリア: はいはいそうだよね、まあ親友ってほどじゃなくても、でもさ、

key: Maybe like a foot in the door towards it?
en: Maybe like a foot in the door towards it?
ja: その方向への第一歩くらいは踏み出せない?

key: Like a little bit of closure?
en: Like a little bit of closure?
ja: ちょっとした区切りっていうか?

key: Like a little bit of closing your foot in the door?
en: Like a little bit of closing your foot in the door?
ja: ドアに足を挟んで、ちょっと閉めちゃう感じの?

key: Just a little hopping up and down swearing in pain and then tripping and falling just out of the camera's view and then the audience hears a random cat meow in shock offscreen???
en: Just a little hopping up and down swearing in pain and then tripping and falling just out of the camera's view and then the audience hears a random cat meow in shock offscreen???
ja: 痛くてぴょんぴょん飛び跳ねながら悪態ついて、それでカメラの外でつまずいて転んで、画面外で観客がびっくりした猫の鳴き声を聞くみたいな感じの???

key: Just a small little tiny itty-bitty little step in the direction of us all being friends again??????
en: Just a small little tiny itty-bitty little step in the direction of us all being friends again??????
ja: アタシたちがまた友達になる方向への、ほんのちっちゃな、小さな、ちいさーい一歩ってだけ??????

key: TITANIA: Just stop.
en: TITANIA: Just stop.
ja: ティタニア: もうやめて。

key: JULIA: Is that a 'no' then?
en: JULIA: Is that a 'no' then?
ja: ジュリア: それって「ノー」ってこと?

key: Even now, after everything?
en: Even now, after everything?
ja: こんなに色々あった後でも?

key: TITANIA: It's a 'no'.
en: TITANIA: It's a 'no'.
ja: ティタニア: 「ノー」よ。

key: Sure, we can set the existing conflict aside to make sure nobody literally dies.
en: Sure, we can set the existing conflict aside to make sure nobody literally dies.
ja: 誰も本当に死なずに済むように、今ある対立を一旦横に置くくらいはできる。

key: We're at least adult enough to do that.
en: We're at least adult enough to do that.
ja: それくらいの大人にはなれてる。

key: That doesn't mean the conflict has changed.
en: That doesn't mean the conflict has changed.
ja: でも対立そのものが変わったわけじゃない。

key: I think we can all stop pretending to deny that by now.
en: I think we can all stop pretending to deny that by now.
ja: もうそれを否定するふりはやめてもいいと思う。

key: You can write it off as being for a happier ending, or for the sake of being friends, but those would be contrivances.
en: You can write it off as being for a happier ending, or for the sake of being friends, but those would be contrivances.
ja: もっと幸せな結末のためとか、友達でいるためとか言い訳もできるけど、それは作り物にすぎない。

key: "Happily ever after" just means the writer stopped paying attention.
en: "Happily ever after" just means the writer stopped paying attention.
ja: 「その後幸せに暮らしました」なんて、作者が注意を払うのをやめただけの話。

key: Growing up from fairy tales means acknowledging that our lives don't end with the writer.
en: Growing up from fairy tales means acknowledging that our lives don't end with the writer.
ja: おとぎ話を卒業するっていうのは、あたしたちの人生は作者と一緒には終わらないって認めること。

key: Not everybody gets closure just because the audience wanted it.
en: Not everybody gets closure just because the audience wanted it.
ja: 観客が望んだからって、誰もが決着をつけられるわけじゃない。

key: Sometimes that's for the best.
en: Sometimes that's for the best.
ja: その方がいいこともある。

key: JULIA: Ooooookay, but what about the rest of us?
en: JULIA: Ooooookay, but what about the rest of us?
ja: ジュリア: はいはいオッケー、でもアタシたち残りの分はどうなるの?

key: What about those of us who just, idk, cared?
en: What about those of us who just, idk, cared?
ja: ただ、その、気にかけてた側の人間はどうなるの?

key: About you two, and about everything we all shared?
en: About you two, and about everything we all shared?
ja: あなたたち二人のこととか、みんなで分かち合ってきた全部のこととか?

key: TITANIA: That's not our problem.
en: TITANIA: That's not our problem.
ja: ティタニア: それはあたしたちの問題じゃない。

key: FLORINIA: Amaria, are you okay with this as well?
en: FLORINIA: Amaria, are you okay with this as well?
ja: フロリニア: アマリア、あなたもこれでいいのですか?

key: AMARIA: To be honest, I prefer a version of myself that doesn't have to lean on others.
en: AMARIA: To be honest, I prefer a version of myself that doesn't have to lean on others.
ja: アマリア: 正直、誰かに頼らなくていい自分の方が好き。

key: I'm not happy about it,
en: I'm not happy about it,
ja: うれしいわけじゃないけど、

key: But it's not like I was happy in the first place either.
en: But it's not like I was happy in the first place either.
ja: そもそも最初から幸せだったわけでもないし。

key: As long as that's the case, isn't it better for the person I care most about to live freely?
en: As long as that's the case, isn't it better for the person I care most about to live freely?
ja: それなら、一番大事な人が自由に生きられる方がいいんじゃない?

key: This is fine.
en: This is fine.
ja: これでいい。

key: I want her to move on.
en: I want her to move on.
ja: あの子には前に進んでほしい。

key: JULIA: Are you sure you're not just telling yourself that?
en: JULIA: Are you sure you're not just telling yourself that?
ja: ジュリア: それ、自分にそう言い聞かせてるだけなんじゃない?

key: AMARIA: Of course I'm just telling myself that.
en: AMARIA: Of course I'm just telling myself that.
ja: アマリア: もちろん自分にそう言い聞かせてるだけよ。

key: It's what I need to hear.
en: It's what I need to hear.
ja: 今のあたしに必要な言葉だから。

key: I'm grateful that I could return the gesture of being the savior, even if just once.
en: I'm grateful that I could return the gesture of being the savior, even if just once.
ja: 一度でも、救う側になって恩返しできたことには感謝してる。

key: But even then, it's a petty notion.
en: But even then, it's a petty notion.
ja: でもそれだって、ちっぽけな考えでしかない。

key: It doesn't change a thing.
en: It doesn't change a thing.
ja: 何も変わりはしない。

key: And I'm also tired of living out lies for the sake of a story I'm still trying to convince myself will end well.
en: And I'm also tired of living out lies for the sake of a story I'm still trying to convince myself will end well.
ja: それに、うまく終わるって自分に言い聞かせ続けてる物語のために、うそを生きるのにも疲れた。

key: TITANIA: Rather than trying to write a happy ending, it's best if we both accept there are better stories for us to live by.
en: TITANIA: Rather than trying to write a happy ending, it's best if we both accept there are better stories for us to live by.
ja: ティタニア: ハッピーエンドを無理に書こうとするより、あたしたち二人とも、もっとふさわしい物語があるって認める方がいい。

key: AMARIA: On that, we can agree.
en: AMARIA: On that, we can agree.
ja: アマリア: それには同意する。

key: JULIA: So that's it, then?
en: JULIA: So that's it, then?
ja: ジュリア: つまりそれで終わりってこと?

key: The four of us, just over, like that?
en: The four of us, just over, like that?
ja: アタシたち四人が、それだけで終わっちゃうの?

key: FLORINIA: The two of them are over, yes.
en: FLORINIA: The two of them are over, yes.
ja: フロリニア: 二人の関係が終わる、という点では、そうです。

key: I don't believe that is meant to exclude either of us inherently.
en: I don't believe that is meant to exclude either of us inherently.
ja: それが本質的に、わたしたちを除外することを意味するとは思いません。

key: JULIA: Whether it's meant to or not...
en: JULIA: Whether it's meant to or not...
ja: ジュリア: そのつもりかどうかは別として……

key: I mean, I still miss the days we could all hang out!
en: I mean, I still miss the days we could all hang out!
ja: だって、みんなで一緒に遊べてた頃が今でも恋しいし!

key: School sucked sometimes, but at least we always had friends around!
en: School sucked sometimes, but at least we always had friends around!
ja: 学校が最悪な時もあったけど、少なくともいつも友達がそばにいたし!

key: And now what, we barely get time to see each other in between various bad things!
en: And now what, we barely get time to see each other in between various bad things!
ja: それが今じゃ、いろんな厄介ごとの合間にちょっと会えるくらいしか時間がないなんて!

key: This sucks!
en: This sucks!
ja: 最悪!

key: FLORINIA: ...If it's any consolation, I at least would be grateful to remain in familiar company more often.
en: FLORINIA: ...If it's any consolation, I at least would be grateful to remain in familiar company more often.
ja: フロリニア: ……慰めになるかわかりませんが、わたしとしては、慣れ親しんだ仲間ともっと一緒にいられたら、それはありがたいことです。

key: JULIA: You expressed a positive and vulnerable emotion!!!
en: JULIA: You expressed a positive and vulnerable emotion!!!
ja: ジュリア: 前向きで、素直な気持ちを口にしたね!!!

key: FLORINIA: ...I have done that a few times here and there.
en: FLORINIA: ...I have done that a few times here and there.
ja: フロリニア: ……そういうことは、これまでも何度かありました。

key: JULIA: Yes, but I'm PROUD OF YOU!!!
en: JULIA: Yes, but I'm PROUD OF YOU!!!
ja: ジュリア: そうだけど、アタシ、あなたのこと誇りに思う!!!

key: JULIA: Okay, then it's settled! You and I are BFFs for life!
en: JULIA: Okay, then it's settled! You and I are BFFs for life!
ja: ジュリア: よし、それなら決まり! あなたとアタシは一生ベストフレンド!

key: So we're doing everything together forever and I'm never leaving you alone!
en: So we're doing everything together forever and I'm never leaving you alone!
ja: だからこれからずっと何でも一緒にやるし、絶対あなたを一人になんてさせない!

key: No take-backsies!!!
en: No take-backsies!!!
ja: 撤回なし!!!
